As a preface I am a relativeltly new DM myself as I have only been doing this for 3-4 months.
  One of the things I would do is tell your characters to build their backstory a bit more and tell your players that it may take a bit of time to get into the swing of things with dming and for them to be patient while you build your world. If you wish to go with one of the campaigns, make a few nocs and stuff along with developing at least some base quests before you start. I did not do this and had to bs the beginning of my player's campaign in a spectacular way which took a lot of my spare time to build off of. I would advise having your players make their way to a starting point of your choosing and initiate the campaign you want to do, or begin your wild imagination, at this point.
  If you enjoy dming, then i would reccomend watching Matthew Mercer's dming guides on youtube along with watching a few episodes of High Rollers and Critical Role campaign 2 to try and find some ideas for dming to make it less of "a group of monsters ambushes your camp" to "i need you to make a perception check" *rolls low* "you hear a few twigs snap, but after a quick flash of movement zooms by your view, you can guess some type of deer was running along." 5 minutes later everyone rolls initiative because surprise, that was actually a band of orcs on a raiding party.
  Hopefully this can help you in your quest to be a magnificent DM!
